name: The Shore Beneath the World
scenePatchesPurpose: Native-size masonry crops remove the three baked objective fires and plinths; runtime beacon sprites alone display their active/extinguished state.
sceneAlignment: The complete cleaned approval scene covers the 48x40 grid. Pixel rectangles below trace safe walking surfaces; cells are selected by their centers. Architecture remains baked into the scene, with blocked footprints and one-tile trial controls at its feet. No repeated-material assembly is used for new chapters.
assembly: scripts/assemble-chapter17-art.js exports assembleChapter17Art(map, image), returning a native Canvas PNG.
alignment: Each tile is drawn 64x64 at (x*64,z*64). All sea cells remain transparent. Source material patches are cropped at native resolution, never stretched. Buildings and single-tile fixtures are separate complete sprites.
